visual_action: A split-screen video. The top panel shows Donald Trump speaking at a podium at a rally in Clinton Township, Michigan. The bottom panel shows a wide-angle shot of a small group of about a dozen supporters standing on a roadside holding flags.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Shown speaking at a podium in the top panel and heard saying, 'We have 9,000 people outside.'

cast.name: Sophia Cai
cast.evidence: Credited in the on-screen text as 'PHOTO: SOPHIA CAI' for the image in the bottom panel.

spoken_summary: Donald Trump claims there is a large crowd at his event, stating, "We have 9,000 people outside."
audio_music: The only audio is Donald Trump's voice speaking, with no accompanying music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video uses a static split-screen format with no cuts, zooms, or other editing effects.
central_claim: Donald Trump falsely inflates the number of his supporters at a rally.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as dishonest and prone to exaggeration about his level of support.
